description: This file defines TypeScript types and interfaces related to MCP (Multi-Checkout Protocol) tools, server catalogs, session runtime management, and their associated data structures and contract methods within the project.

methods.name: markUsed
methods.description: Marks the current runtime as used.

methods.name: callTool
methods.description: Calls a specific tool on a server with provided input and returns the result.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with the runtime.

methods.name: getOrCreate
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a new SessionMcpRuntime instance based on provided parameters.

methods.name: bindSessionKey
methods.description: Associates a session key with a session ID.

methods.name: resolveSessionId
methods.description: Resolves a session ID from a session key.

methods.name: disposeSession
methods.description: Disposes of a specific session by ID.

methods.name: disposeAll
methods.description: Disposes all sessions managed by the runtime manager.

methods.name: listSessionIds
methods.description: Returns a list of all session IDs.
